subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits

items.prompt:
A trait is
A) a feature of a living thing, like fur color
B) a kind of food
C) a type of weather
D) a sound
items.answer: A) a feature of a living thing, like fur color

steps: A trait is a feature such as color or height.

items.prompt:
Inherited means a trait is
A) passed from parents to offspring
B) bought at a store
C) made of rock
D) random with no cause
items.answer: A) passed from parents to offspring

steps: Inherited traits come from the parents.

items.prompt:
Puppies with floppy ears like their mother show that floppy ears is
A) inherited
B) bought
C) learned in school
D) weather

steps: Sharing the parent's trait shows it was inherited.

items.prompt:
Differences in a trait within a group of the same kind of organism is called
A) inheritance
B) variation
C) weather
D) a life cycle

steps: Variation is differences within a group.

items.prompt:
Sunflowers from one parent plant are different heights. This is an example of
A) variation
B) weather
C) a food chain
D) erosion

steps: Different heights in the same group show variation.

items.prompt:
A chart shows most kittens match a parent's color but a few differ. This shows
A) only inheritance
B) only variation
C) both inheritance and variation
D) neither

steps: Matching shows inheritance; differences show variation.

items.prompt:
A graph of classmates' heights showing a range of values is evidence of
A) inheritance only
B) variation
C) weather
D) erosion

steps: A range of heights within a group shows variation.

items.prompt:
Two purple-flowered pea plants have mostly purple-flowered offspring. The best conclusion is that flower color is
A) inherited
B) caused by the weather
C) random with no cause
D) learned

steps: Offspring matching parents suggests the trait was inherited.
